title: 咘咘学会等一等
title_en: Bubu Learns to Wait Her Turn

pages.text_en: Bubu Learns to Wait Her Turn

pages.text: 夏天的一个下午，咘咘和爸爸妈妈开车去海边。车里放着咘咘最爱的儿歌，她一边跟着唱，一边摇头晃脑。
pages.text_en: One summer afternoon, Bubu and her parents were driving to the beach. Her favorite children's song was playing, and she sang along, bobbing her head happily.

pages.text: 爸爸轻轻说：“咘咘，爸爸也想听一首自己喜欢的歌，好不好？”咘咘马上撅起小嘴：“不要不要！我要听我的歌！”
pages.text_en: Dad said gently, “Bubu, can Daddy listen to one of his songs too?” Bubu pouted right away: “No no! I want MY song!”

pages.text: 妈妈也说：“妈妈也有一首很好听的歌呢。”可咘咘捂住耳朵，大声说：“我不要听别的歌！只听咘咘的！”
pages.text_en: Mom added, “Mommy has a really nice song too.” But Bubu covered her ears and said loudly, “I don’t want other songs! Only Bubu’s!”

pages.text: 到了海边，爸爸妈妈坐在毯子上聊天。咘咘跑过来，一直拉妈妈的手：“妈妈！妈妈！你看那个贝壳！妈妈！你看！”
pages.text_en: At the beach, Mom and Dad sat on a blanket chatting. Bubu ran over and kept tugging Mom’s hand: “Mommy! Mommy! Look at that shell! Mommy! Look!”

pages.text: 妈妈还没说完话，咘咘又喊：“妈妈快来！妈妈！”爸爸妈妈对视了一下，笑着叹了口气。
pages.text_en: Before Mom could finish her sentence, Bubu called again: “Mommy come quick! Mommy!” Mom and Dad exchanged a glance and sighed with a smile.

pages.text: 这时候，NOMI抱着一个沙滩球走过来，笑眯眯地说：“咘咘，我有一个超好玩的游戏，叫‘轮流小达人’！想不想玩？”
pages.text_en: Just then, NOMI walked over carrying a beach ball, smiling: “Bubu, I have a super fun game called ‘Take Turns Champion’! Want to play?”

pages.text: NOMI解释说：“规则很简单——每个人轮流选一首歌、轮流说一件想说的事。轮到谁的时候，其他人要安安静静地听。”NONO在旁边拍着翅膀说：“我先来我先来！”
pages.text_en: NOMI explained: “The rules are simple — everyone takes turns picking a song and sharing something. When it’s someone’s turn, everyone else listens quietly.” NONO flapped his wings nearby: “Me first! Me first!”

pages.text: 于是大家围坐在沙滩上，开始玩轮流游戏。先是NONO的回合——他唱了一首叽叽喳喳的小鸟歌，虽然跑调了，但大家都笑着听完了。
pages.text_en: So everyone sat in a circle on the beach and started the game. It was NONO’s turn first — he sang a chirpy little bird song. It was totally off-key, but everyone listened and laughed.

pages.text: 然后是爸爸的回合。爸爸放了一首吉他曲，轻轻地跟着哼。咘咘本来想说话，但看到NOMI竖起一根手指放在嘴边，就忍住了。她安静地听着，发现……这首歌好像也蛮好听的。
pages.text_en: Then it was Dad’s turn. He played a guitar song and hummed along softly. Bubu wanted to say something, but saw NOMI hold a finger to her lips, so she held back. She listened quietly and realized... this song was actually pretty nice.

pages.text: 妈妈的回合到了。妈妈说：“我小时候也最爱去海边，外婆会给我编贝壳手链。”咘咘瞪大眼睛：“真的吗？外婆也会编手链？”
pages.text_en: Mom’s turn came. She said, “When I was little, I loved the beach too. Grandma used to make me shell bracelets.” Bubu’s eyes went wide: “Really? Grandma makes bracelets too?”

pages.text: 终于轮到咘咘了！她开心地分享了自己捡到的那个粉色贝壳，还唱了一首最爱的歌。所有人都认认真真地听她唱完，还鼓起了掌。咘咘觉得好开心——原来被人认真听的感觉，这么好！
pages.text_en: Finally it was Bubu’s turn! She happily shared the pink shell she found and sang her favorite song. Everyone listened carefully and clapped when she finished. Bubu felt so happy — so this is what it feels like when people really listen!

pages.text: 回家的车上，爸爸放了自己喜欢的歌。咘咘安安静静地靠在安全座椅上，听着听着，轻轻地说：“爸爸的歌也好听。下一首轮到我选哦！”NOMI和NONO在后座相视一笑。夕阳透过车窗，照在咘咘微笑的脸上。
pages.text_en: On the way home, Dad played his favorite song. Bubu sat quietly in her car seat, listened for a while, then said softly, “Daddy’s song is nice too. Next one is my turn to pick!” NOMI and NONO smiled at each other in the back seat. The sunset shone through the window onto Bubu’s smiling face.
